notes: Aging Fly Cell Atlas (Lu et al. 2023, Science; FBrf0256843), rebuilt from GEO GSE218661 and the authors' own head/body AnnData analyses, replacing the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006422 (scRNAseq_2023_AFCA: per-age re-analyses D30 FBlc0006423, D50 FBlc0006887, D70 FBlc0007347, head and body merged, clusters merged by type, plus female/male sub-datasets) with fresh VFBseq ids. Licence CC-BY-4.0 (curator-confirmed 2026-10-15). Curator decisions 2026-10-15: one Clustering per author analysis (head, body); one Cluster per author `afca_annotation` type over all ages; new general rule — reuse truly identical entities from other studies by VFBseq id (curate the source study first): the 5-day cells are FCA 10x head/body cells (same barcodes and libraries), so the 26 FCA head/body Samples and their Assays are reused from li_2022_fca_10x, linked from the AFCA Clusterings (associated_sample_or_assay_for_clustering), not re-minted. Samples (stage 1): 72 GEO samples = 72 10x libraries (head/body x sex x 30/50/70 d x 6); flies F1 of female W1118 x male Oregon R (no stock numbers given); stage FBdv day 30/50/70 of adulthood; tissue adult head / adult postcephalic region; sex from GEO. Clusters (stage 2): 164 entries (91 head, 73 body; 566,254 cells); held, not loaded: 2 'unannotated' groups (leftover) and 'neuron 1'-'neuron 17' (untyped). Mapping (stage 3, FBbt 2026-10-01): AFCA labels transferred from the FCA (preprint methods), so each type takes the FCA's curator-reviewed type-level mapping (133 by name, 10 _head/_body types by alias); 2 new types via report + map-clusters-to-fbbt: cyst cell -> cyst cell of testis (broad), seminal vesicle & testis epithelia -> adult epithelial cell (broad), accepted by the curator 2026-10-15; held as in the FCA: Poxn neuron, female reproductive system. 143 Clusters mapped, 130 distinct FBbt terms (verify_mappings OK). Review dates: FCA-derived 2026-10-14, new 2026-10-15. Cross-checks: 93 of the old load's 100 FBbt terms reused; fca_5d_conflicts.tsv lists 16 types whose 5-day cells the FCA typed with a different, non-broader term (information only). No FBbt term requests. Expression (stage 4): X (log1p(CP10k), all genes) -> CPM; gene ids from the FCA 10x files by symbol, else Chado (FB2026_03): 15,891 current, 80 secondary, 20 synonym, 1 split dropped (2 merges); 15,989 genes x 566,254 cells, 143 clusters, 133,771 rows (extent > 0.2); Dataset total/filtered gene counts 15,962 / 5,399 (held clusters included). Build (stage 5): 1 Dataset, 72 Samples, 72 Assays, 2 Clusterings, 143 Clusters; every FBbt/FBdv/FBcv term on Samples, Assays and the Dataset checked current in OLS (2026-10-15). Publication FBrf0256843 resolved from VFB production (pdb).
